employee.title: My space
employee.description: Your schedule, leave, attendance, timesheets, tasks, expenses and monthly compensation in one place.

cards.leave: Request leave, follow your requests and see each decision.

approvals.title: Leave approvals assigned to you

substitutions.title: Shift substitutions to decide

teamAttendance.title: Team attendance to record
teamAttendance.description: Some of your direct reports’ shifts need a check-in or a check-out now. You can record it for them, with a reason they will see.

expenseApprovals.title: Expense approvals routed to you
expenseApprovals.description: If employees’ expenses are routed to you as their manager, they appear here for your approval. This page is empty unless you manage employees.

salaryAdvances.description: Advances through approved partners, with employee consent, repaid through payroll.
